Educational Thread: How Do I Manage Gap Up on Focus Name.

for $BE, the gap up consideration is only on multiple ATR% from 50-MA. If you look at the most recent historical multiple that it will retrace, it done it right smack at 10x. any gap up beyond 4 x ATR% from 50-MA i will give it a miss. the nuances is if a high ADR% name has recent historical multiple extension beyond 10 x marginally (eg. 14x, 20x), I will take the idea at Focus even if it gap up at 5 x ATR% from 50-MA. but it's pretty rare and such name will already be in most ppl's focus list due to the initial stage of parabolic run

$PURR is the same case, the gap up already exceeded beyond 4x multiple, so i will not even think about doing an ORH on this. This is not a Focus name in the first place, but i am using it as an example
$NASA ETF looks good but it's only 2.6% ADR

$CRSR - Update

sometimes the work during weekends is to study and innovate/create on the entry when you have conviction (whether technical or fundamental) behind a particular setup

Update $ARKG

Didn't get the sideway tightened action. I am ok to let it go considering it's only 3.4% ADR. There will always be opportunities like this
not a bad thing to give it a miss due to ATR% extension rule. i will continue to stalk this for sideway move and ATR% multiple compression
